_doc: DISTRIBUTION ENVELOPE MANIFEST (epistemic prevention, wave EP-1).
One canonical home for every derived rate/count bound in the estate. A test reads
instead of hardcoding an integer, so a bound and its provenance can never drift
apart. tests/lint/distributionEnvelopePower.test.js re-derives every entry from its
measured base rate and reds if the registered bound, the margin, or the provenance
Entry schema: id, file, n, baseRate, baseMeasuredAt, baseMeasurementN (>= 400),
loosenPending=true means the DERIVED bound is looser than the live one. The live
(tighter) bound stays in force and the derivation goes to the owner queue — program
law: never loosen a bound silently.
The TOTALITY ROSTER — which distribution-shaped test files owe an entry here — lives
in tests/lint/distributionEnvelopePower.test.js as a frozen, shrink-only literal, not
in this file. Rows there start pendingMigration and retire as wave EP-2D measures each
base rate and registers the derivation below. This file starts empty by design.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 d0fdcf7c, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: 1/400 ordinary cities read corrupted at birth. THIN BASE: a single observed event, so alpha is set to 1e-4 rather than the program default 1e-3 — the extra decade of budget is a hedge on the base rate itself, not on the corpus (which is seeded and fixed). At 1e-3 the derivation is 6. The authored ceiling was Math.round(400*0.025)=10, shared with the town and village sweeps; adopting 7 tightens it.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 d0fdcf7c, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: THE TRIGGER INSTRUMENT of the epistemic-prevention program. 27/400 = 6.75% of 90-criminal-priority towns reach full capture. The live ceiling 40 (Math.round(400*0.1)) is KEPT: the alpha-1e-3 envelope derives 45, which is LOOSER, and program law forbids an agent loosening a bound. Not a defect — 40 carries 2.59 sigma and is EXACTLY the alpha-1e-2 derivation, so the loosening is a strictness choice for the owner, not a repair. Owner ruling wanted: keep 40 (1% budget) or adopt 45 (0.1% budget).

entries.notes: 15/400 = 3.75% of 90-criminal-priority cities reach full capture (the file header's older ~4.0% figure was 16/400). The authored ceiling was the SAME expression as the town sweep, Math.round(400*0.1)=40, which left the city bound 6.58 sigma out — loose by accident, because one expression was serving two different rates. Separated and tightened to 29.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 d0fdcf7c, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: 397/400 criminal-heavy cities read equilibrium or worse. THIN BASE in the informative tail (3 non-events), so alpha is 1e-4 rather than 1e-3 (which derives 389). The authored floor was Math.round(400*0.5)=200 — 114 sigma below the mean, a floor that could only red if the mechanism were deleted outright. The town half of the same assertion measures 400/400 and is degenerate: it keeps its authored 50% floor un-derived.

entries.notes: genRelNarrative emits a phrasing for 229/400 seeds of the `relationship-grammar-${i}` family (57.25%). The pre-migration floor was a hand-picked `> 40` sitting 8.1 sigma BELOW the mean of 91.6 — it could only have reddened if emission collapsed by more than half. The derived floor 71 keeps 3.29 sigma of power; the test's own 160-draw corpus measures 87.
